records.subject: Stretchable ionic thermoelectric capacitor
records.object: Host-guest complexation between alpha-CD and I3-
records.quote: This study introduces a novel design for ionic thermoelectric capacitors (ITECs) by incorporating host-guest complexation between alpha-cyclodextrin (alpha-CD) and triiodide ions (I3-).
context_quotes: Furthermore, the stretchable ITEC demonstrates a substantial power density of 5.9 mW m-2.
